items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And then that would be the band where we started with the three tenors and baritone exclusively. >> [(note)] Al Cohn [INTERVIEWEE] And so Hal Cohen was there and Zoot.

ctx.x: Yeah. Then I went back to New York and started to reorganize again. I think I took a rest for a little bit, but it was shortly after. And then that would be the band where we started with the three tenors and baritone exclusively.
And so Hal Cohen was there and Zoot.
